True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def line_positions(axis):
        n = h if axis == 0 else w
        m = w if axis == 0 else h
        result = []
        for i in range(n):
            vals = [grid[i][j] if axis == 0 else grid[j][i] for j in range(m)]
            counts = Counter(v for v in vals if v != fill)
            if counts and max(counts.values()) / m >= 0.65:
                result.append(i)
        return result

    rows = line_positions(0)
    cols = line_positions(1)
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    line_counts = Counter()
    for r in rows:
        line_counts.update(v for v in grid[r] if v != fill)
    for c in cols:
        line_counts.update(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != fill)
    divider = line_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    specials = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(rows) for ci, c in enumerate(cols)
                if grid[r][c] != fill and grid[r][c] != divider]
    if not specials:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, c in specials)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in specials)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in specials)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in specials)
    out = [[fill for _ in range(c1-c0)] for _ in range(r1-r0)]
    for rr in range(r0, r1):
        for cc in range(c0, c1):
            vals = [grid[rows[rr]][cols[cc]], grid[rows[rr]][cols[cc+1]],
                    grid[rows[rr+1]][cols[cc]], grid[rows[rr+1]][cols[cc+1]]]
            if vals[0] != fill and vals[0] != divider and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
                out[rr-r0][cc-c0] = vals[0]
    return out
